games.name: Azure Mines
games.desc:
You're in charge of restoring an old mining facility back to its former glory. 

Use the ore you uncover in the Azure Mines to rebuild your base. In this unique tycoon & mining game hybrid, all of your progress saves and loads automatically. Featuring responsive Xbox controls, this lightweight game ensures a smooth experience regardless of where you're playing it.

Massive randomly-generated caves, tons of detailed hand-designed ore, a unique tycoon element, a robust building system and an integrated level progression sets Azure Mines far apart from previous mining games on Roblox. See for yourself!

[Open Source] Want to make your own game like this? Use the Infinite Mining Game Kit to get started in minutes! No scripting knowledge required. https://www.roblox.com/library/4920625917/Infinite-Mining-Game-Kit-by-berezaa

games.name: Linglox
games.desc:
PLAYING LINGO BEFORE PLAYING THIS IS RECOMMENDED HEAVILY
Find it just by searching lingothegame. The first result is the official website!

Linglox, you're set in a large world, able to roam around and solve all of the word puzzle objects called "Prompts". You're capable of finding alternative answers to Prompts throughout your gameplay, be careful! With over 10000+ Prompts to solve and 100+ Prompt colors, you're going to climb your way up to the title of a mastermind.

To solve a Prompt, type in the correct answer! The color and height of the block matter. 

Inspired by: Brenton Wildes' "Lingo I & II" and Arvi Teikari's "Baba Is You"

Created by: Many People...
Artwork credits: Moon, Croutons and Ange for badge icons and loading screens, they're awesome, go check them out (@._moon_moon_.), (@croutons0292), (@cosmoshining)! 
Check the art gallery for the community's art!
